text_block_list.name: URA Official with Black Glasses
text_block_list.text:
...I don't know whether to say 'as 
expected' or just be speechless.

text_block_list.name: URA Official with Black Glasses
text_block_list.text:
His usual overbearing aura was nowhere to 
be seen, indeed...

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
"However, we must proceed with caution. 
...Let us continue visiting the racetrack 
from now on."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Very well, not bad for an opening move. 
Pieces must be advanced one square at a 
time.)

With the Osaka Hai over, we held a brief 
meeting in the lobby of our lodging.
choice_data_list:
Maybe the Takarazuka Kinen for our next 
target race.

text_block_list.text:
The GⅠ race that caps off the first half 
of the Senior Year. She had wanted to run 
in it for a while now to use as leverage 
for going overseas.

Even putting that aside, if we're aiming 
for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe down the 
road, it's a challenge we definitely want 
to take on.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That's during the rainy season, so 
the footing easily gets bad.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Focus intensively on building stamina. 
Make sure to schedule several mock races 
as well.
choice_data_list: Got it, let's do our best together!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, hold on. Before that comes the 
Fan Appreciation Festival, huh?"

The Fan Appreciation Festival is like a 
school festival where Tracen Academy opens 
its doors to interact with fans.
choice_data_list:
Did something happen with the Fan 
Thanksgiving Festival?

Did something happen with the Fan 
Thanksgiving Festival?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The attendance at that event is no joke. I 
can even face off against folks I usually 
don't get to.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It's convenient for drawing attention. 
It'll take a bit of preparation, though—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Well, don't you worry about it. Just 
focus on what you need to do for the 
Takarazuka Kinen.

Sirius Symboli is scheming something. It 
piqued my curiosity, but... just as she 
said, I should focus on preparing for the 
next target race.

The Takarazuka Kinen, that glorious Grand 
Prix race, is never a simple matter, after 
all.
